sql:
-- Check if there are drivers with 0 overtakes
WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' 
      AND lap > 1
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position,
        LAG(lap) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_lap
    FROM race_laps
),
pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap AS pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE CAST(lap_type AS VARCHAR) LIKE 'Retirement%'
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT wp.race_id, wp.driver_id, wp.lap, wp.position, wp.prev_position, wp.prev_lap
    FROM with_prev wp
    LEFT JOIN pit_stop_laps psl ON wp.race_id = psl.race_id AND wp.driver_id = psl.driver_id 
        AND (wp.lap = psl.pit_lap OR wp.prev_lap = psl.pit_lap)
    LEFT JOIN retirement_laps rl ON wp.race_id = rl.race_id AND wp.driver_id = rl.driver_id 
        AND (wp.lap = rl.lap OR wp.prev_lap = rl.lap)
    WHERE psl.pit_lap IS NULL
      AND rl.lap IS NULL
      AND wp.prev_position IS NOT NULL
),
classified AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, prev_position,
        CASE WHEN position < prev_position THEN 'overtake' 
             WHEN position > prev_position THEN 'being_overtaken'
             ELSE 'no_change' END AS change_type
    FROM filtered
),
counts AS (
    SELECT driver_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN change_type = 'overtake' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_overtakes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN change_type = 'being_overtaken' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_being_overtaken
    FROM classified
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT * FROM counts WHERE total_overtakes = 0 ORDER BY total_being_overtaken DESC LIMIT 10;
